push.title: L 1-3 vs Bubba Bros Fc | You: 7.7 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.7 is your 3rd best match performance of the season. Middle of your road, heading the right way.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Bubba Bros Fc's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ Most passes attempted you've had in 6 matches for us (42). You can build a whole match on that.
+ That 7.7 is your 3rd best match performance of the season. Put it on the fridge.
+ 1 key pass: +0.2. That's money in the bank.
+ 3 goals conceded added +0.1. Like interest on savings.

THE BAD
- 67% passing (28 of 42, down from your usual 76%). Simple as pie: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. I've seen you do harder things.
- Shots on target: 75%. 90%+ is where top forwards hang their hats.
- Key passes: 1. Good foundation, 2+ ceiling.
- Missed tackles 5, from 2 in your previous match. Let's not make that a pattern.
- Lost 1-3 to Bubba Bros Fc. Chins up, cleats on.

Quick drill: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

PhogsToffees, here's what I'd tell my own kid: The scoreboard counts goals; I count growth.

Stay curious about your game. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-3 vs Bubba Bros Fc | You: 7.2 (worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your worst match performance of the season, BellyTb1: a 7.2. It stings, and stings fade.

THE GOOD
+ 1 assist. You made your teammates look like heroes. That's real leadership.
+ PhogsToffees scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ Tackles attempted 3, up from your usual 1. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.
+ 16 completed passes put +0.3 on the board for you.

THE BAD
- Won 0 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 44%). Real quick: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- Shot conversion 0%, down from your usual 32%. That's not you at your best, and we both know it.
- That 7.2 sits as your worst match performance of the season. Next one's the bounce-back.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Training homework: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- 6 misplaced passes: -0.1. A little care goes a long way.

Rep it: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.

BellyTb1, write this on your hand if you have to: You can't rush a good brisket or a good player.

Let the lesson stick, let the frustration go. - Coach Lasso
